Here some game catalogue (wallpaper and Furniture) Retexture, to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20337]Mole's furniture[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27122]wallpapers[/url]﻿, and more!.
- I was thinking on adding them to my future furniture retexture pack, but they aren't furnitures or craftables <:'3c -

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Catalogue Retexture [/b]- Retexture the Vanilla Catalogue -Wallpaper & Furniture- with [Content Patcher] and [GMCM][/*]
[*][b][AT][/b] [b][b]Molamole's Catalogue Retexture[/b] [/b]- Retexture the Vanilla Catalogue -Wallpaper & Furniture- with [Alternative Texture][/*]
[*][b][AT][/b] [b][b]Molamole's Catalogue Retexture[/b] - Desaturated [/b]- Retexture the Vanilla Catalogue -Wallpaper & Furniture- with [Alternative Texture], Desaturated version[/*]
[/list]

None (for now), leave a comment if there's any problem!
